prologue1.text: My family repaired pumps, patched sails, and got paid in promises. I learned to draw charts on delivery trips. At least a coastline usually keeps its word.

prologue2.text: I came to Brindle Quay with a notebook, a pencil, and a plan: find surveying work, save for a boat, and stop drawing horizons I couldn't reach.

prologue3.text: First, a job. Preferably one with supper. The Crooked Compass looked promising. I hadn't yet learned that, in this harbour, even the tide came with terms and conditions.
